novoe.zakrepit_text: The screenshot hangs on top of all windows like a sticker: drag it with the mouse. Size: pull an edge or corner, or use the wheel. Unpin: the cross in the corner, Esc, double click or right button. The Pin button is in the editor and in the selection window, key F3.

zakrepit.tip:
Pin the screenshot on top of windows (F3)
The screenshot hangs as a separate small window. Size: drag an edge or corner, or use the mouse wheel. Ctrl+wheel: transparency. Unpin: the cross in the corner, Esc, double click or right button
zakrepit.training: Practice image: it is not pinned on top of windows.
zakrepit.wayland_hint: This desktop may not keep the window on top. If it goes under others: Alt+Space, then “Always on Top”.
